available.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT FROM hybrid_apexrun_presence.instance p
  WHERE p.id = racer AND p.state->>'phase' = 'visible'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.state->'leases') l
    WHERE (l->>'until')::bigint > hybrid_apexrun_presence.clock()))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM hybrid_apexrun_duel.member m JOIN hybrid_apexrun_duel.instance d ON d.id = m.instance_id
    WHERE m.actor = racer AND d.state->>'phase' IN ('waiting', 'signalling', 'racing'));

checks.sql: target IS NOT NULL AND current_actor <> target

NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM hybrid_apexrun_challenge.instance c WHERE c.state->>'phase' = 'offered' AND (c.state->>'deadline')::bigint > hybrid_apexrun_challenge.clock() AND c.state->>'inviter' = current_actor::text)

inviter_name.raw: (SELECT state->>'name' FROM hybrid_apexrun_presence.instance WHERE id = current_actor)

target_name.raw: (SELECT state->>'name' FROM hybrid_apexrun_presence.instance WHERE id = target)

admission.input: jsonb_build_object('inviter', current_actor, 'target', target, 'stage', stage, 'seed', seed::bigint, 'duel', md5('apexrun_duel/' || challenge_id::text)::uuid, 'inviter_name', (SELECT state->>'name' FROM hybrid_apexrun_presence.instance WHERE id = current_actor), 'target_name', (SELECT state->>'name' FROM hybrid_apexrun_presence.instance WHERE id = target))
admission.locks: PERFORM 1 FROM "hybrid_apexrun_presence"."instance" WHERE "id" IN (current_actor, target) ORDER BY "id" FOR UPDATE;

transitions.sql:
PERFORM hybrid_apexrun_duel.spawn((game.state->>'duel')::uuid, jsonb_build_object('stage', game.state->>'stage', 'seed', (game.state->>'seed')::bigint), jsonb_build_object('a', game.state->>'inviter', 'b', game.state->>'target'), now_ms);
PERFORM hybrid_apexrun_duel.deliver((game.state->>'duel')::uuid, jsonb_build_object('kind', 'start', 'payload', jsonb_build_object('seats', '["a","b"]'::jsonb)), now_ms);
